home.intro: Livicee is the DJ side of me. Five mixes, from the slow open to the wind-down.

about.title:
Open format.
Good instincts.
about.lede: Great music, good energy and a feel for the room.
about.body: I'm Livi, an open-format DJ who knows how to read a room, work a crowd and create the right energy for any occasion. From private parties and packed dancefloors to international brand events, I've played across London, Las Vegas, Copenhagen, Cannes, Lisbon, Singapore and Zurich. My sets have taken me to venues including Printworks, Poble Espanyol, Tivoli, Aquário Romano, the Cannes Croisette, Ace Hotel and Be At One. I've worked with clients and events including Google, Cannes Lions, Shoptalk, Money20/20, London Pride, Virgin Atlantic, Delta Air Lines and Silent Discos in Incredible Places. I play across genres and decades, combining crowd favourites with unexpected selections. Whether it's a hands-in-the-air moment or a carefully curated soundtrack, the music always serves the room.

principles.title: Parties & celebrations
principles.body: Open-format DJ sets for birthdays, private parties and celebrations. Big singalongs, dancefloor favourites and unexpected tracks that make a night memorable.

principles.title: Weddings & events
principles.body: Music tailored to the occasion, from relaxed receptions and stylish gatherings to full dancefloors. Thoughtful selections, seamless transitions and the flexibility to follow the crowd.

principles.title: Corporate events & sound programming
principles.body: Curated soundtracks for brand experiences, launches and corporate events, including walk-on music, event openings, transitions and bespoke music programming.
